rows.note: The exact openssl command from docs/api/en/proxy.md run with OpenSSL 3.6.3 (cert has critical CA:TRUE, SAN DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1); backend served key.pem+cert.pem, proxy given cert.pem: 200 at https://localhost and https://127.0.0.1 (OpenSSL 4.0.3 output has the same extensions).

Backend limited to TLSv1.2 (session-ID resumption): two layered connections through TrustedCertificates.fromPem get different session IDs. Control: a single-SSLContext factory makes the same test fail (resumed), so the test is not vacuous.
16 concurrent TlsConnector.layer(plain, localhost, port, ..., factory) calls through one trustCertificates factory, with the host name check, all reach the backend.
getDefaultCipherSuites/getSupportedCipherSuites equal those of a fresh TLS context's factory and are non-empty.

Given {not-yet-valid (+6s) self-signed presented cert, valid unrelated self-signed}: first request 502, after the presented cert becomes valid the cached delegate is rebuilt and the request gets 200 (no stale cache, no false rejection).
